annotation.title_clean: GB/T 48317.2-2026 人形机器人技术要求 第2部分：环境感知
annotation.title_en: GB/T 48317.2-2026 Technical requirements for humanoid robots — Part 2: Environmental perception
annotation.authors_or_issuer: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR); Standardization Administration of China (SAC)
annotation.venue: National Public Service Platform for Standards Information (openstd.samr.gov.cn)
annotation.summary_en: This is a catalogue page on China's national standards platform listing GB/T 48317.2-2026, a recommended national standard on technical requirements for humanoid robots (Part 2: environmental perception). It was published on 28 September 2026, takes effect on 1 April 2027 and is classified under ICS 25 (mechanical manufacturing). The page shows only metadata, not the standard's text.
key_provisions_or_claims: Recommended (voluntary) Chinese national standard GB/T 48317.2-2026 on environmental perception requirements for humanoid robots
Part of a multi-part GB/T 48317 series on humanoid robot technical requirements
